title: Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy Rate Pages
content:
Annual rates for the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy, by tier. Every rate is an annual figure in US dollars.

| Rate item | 1M | 2M | 3M | 4M | 5M | 10M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base annual premium (named insured household with the included exposures) | $268.00 | $392.00 | $507.00 | $613.00 | $709.00 | $1184.00 |
| Vehicles included in the base premium | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Annual premium per vehicle beyond the included vehicles | $48.00 | $62.00 | $76.00 | $88.00 | $98.00 | $151.00 |
| Age under which a household driver is rated as youthful | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |
| Annual premium per youthful driver | $97.00 | $131.00 | $162.00 | $186.00 | $207.00 | $292.00 |
| Rental dwelling units included in the base premium | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Annual premium per rental dwelling unit beyond the included units | $36.00 | $48.00 | $58.00 | $66.00 | $74.00 | $112.00 |
| Annual premium per scheduled watercraft | $42.00 | $55.00 | $66.00 | $76.00 | $84.00 | $126.00 |

## Definitions used on these pages

- **Base annual premium.** The annual premium for the named insured household together with the exposures the base premium includes.
- **Included vehicles and included rental units.** The number of vehicles, and of rental dwelling units, that the base annual premium already includes. No watercraft and no youthful driver is included in the base annual premium on any tier; the tables show no inclusion for either.
- **Youthful driver.** A household driver whose age is under the figure shown, which is 25 on every tier. A driver aged 24 is under 25 and is rated as youthful; a driver aged 25 is not under 25 and is not.
- **Per vehicle, per rental unit, per youthful driver, per watercraft.** Each is an annual rate charged for each such exposure it applies to.

## Points of reading

- Larkspur Umbrella 10M includes three vehicles and two rental units in its base premium; Larkspur Umbrella 4M and 5M include two vehicles and one rental unit; Larkspur Umbrella 1M, 2M and 3M include two vehicles and no rental unit.
- The youthful driver age of 25 is the same on all six tiers; only the youthful driver rate differs.
